text: Here is the question itself, from June 2023. Read it. Then watch the three marks land on our graph: Vmax shown, half Vmax shown, eighteen. And the tablet? Its molecule binds one enzyme, reversibly, in the active site or beside it, and other enzymes have different active sites, so a molecule that fits one need not fit the rest. Which kind of inhibitor it is, you can now read off a graph.
